evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge, a forceful directive registering alarm or frustration.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Imperative 'Remove all knowledge' with exhaustive enumeration signals urgent, high-arousal insistence — activated-negative affect.
Flat declarative with 'never' settles into low-arousal negation — resignation or weary correction rather than energized alarm.
